en: A colorized panoramic view over a green hilly landscape with scattered trees and small farm buildings in the foreground. On the hill in the distance stands a town with a large church or castle-like complex with a tower, adjoining buildings with red roofs, and nearby medieval-looking ruins and walls. Additional village houses and another church-like building with a tower and red roofs appear to the right. At the top left, printed text reads "Frauenstein i. Erzgeb."
